title: FieldServiceOrgSettings - Data API
description: Represents the org settings for Field Service, such as Appointment Assistant settings. If Field Service is enabled, the org contains one read-only record of this object. This object is available in API version 51.0 and later.

ApptAssistantExpiration.description: The expiry time in minutes of when the customer stops seeing the mobile worker’s location. Appointment Assistant must also be enabled to see this field.

ApptAssistantInfoUrl.description: The page URL that enables Appointment Assistant. Appointment Assistant must also be enabled to see this field.

ApptAssistantRadiusUnit.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
ApptAssistantRadiusUnit.description: The unit of the radius of the service appointment that prompts the Last Mile event for Appointment Assistant. Appointment Assistant must also be enabled to see this field. Possible values are: Kilometer Meter Mile Yard

ApptAssistantRadiusValue.description: The radius of the service appointment that prompts the Last Mile event for Appointment Assistant. Appointment Assistant must also be enabled to see this field.

ApptAssistantStatus.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort
ApptAssistantStatus.description: The value that prompts the En Route event for Appointment Assistant. Appointment Assistant must also be enabled to see this field. Possible values are: Canceled Cannot Complete Completed Dispatched In Progress None Scheduled TestSharing The default value is 'None'.

CanPopulateGoogleAddress.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
CanPopulateGoogleAddress.description: Allows desktop and mobile to send geolocation and map data to Google and Apple. Available in API version 57.0 and later. The default value is true.

CanSendAppCenterCrashReports.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
CanSendAppCenterCrashReports.description: Allows Salesforce to send crash reports to Microsoft App Center. Available in API version 57.0 and later. The default value is true.

CanStoreMobileAnalytics.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
CanStoreMobileAnalytics.description: Allows third parties to store mobile analytics. Available in API version 57.0 and later. The default value is true.

DeveloperName.description: The unique name of the object in the API. Note: Only users with View DeveloperName OR View Setup and Configuration permission can view, group, sort, and filter this field.

DoesAvlCalcInclOvertime.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
DoesAvlCalcInclOvertime.description: Specifies whether overtime is included in work capacity availability calculations. Available in API version 59.0 and later. The default value is false.

DoesAvlCalcInclPrimOnly.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
DoesAvlCalcInclPrimOnly.description: Specifies if primary members only are included in work capacity availability calculations. If the value is false both primary and secondary members of the service territory are included. Available in API version 59.0 and later. The default value is false.

Language.description: The language of the field service org settings. The format for the values is a two-letter language code in small letters, for example, fr for French. If the language has regional dialects, add the two-letter country code in capital letters, for example, use fr_BE for Belgian French.

MasterLabel.description: The label of the field service org settings.

special_access_rules:
To see this object, Field Service must be enabled. For specified fields in the table, Appointment Assistant must also be enabled.
